a: Under NSF 23-519: Track 1 $100k to $1.4M; Track 2 $1.4M to $4M; Track 3 (helium conservation) $100k to $4M
dt: No FY2026 window (NSF funded more FY2025 proposals instead). NSF had signaled an Oct 15 to Nov 16, 2026 window, but NSF 23-519 is archived and the FY2027 solicitation is 'waiting for new publication'
e: Limited submission under 23-519: max 2 Track 1, 1 Track 2 and 1 Track 3 per organization (Yale internal competition). Cost sharing was waived for 5 yrs starting with FY2023 (would cover FY2027 unless changed).
unv: FY2027 solicitation not published; Oct-Nov 2026 window unconfirmed; limits and cost share may change

yale.t: Yale internal application for NSF 23-519 MRI (up to $4M), sponsor deadline Nov 16, 2026. Apply via InfoReady. The internal deadline has passed.
yale.unv: Source is the Mar 11, Mar 18, Apr 1 and Apr 8, 2026 Yale Funding Opportunities newsletters.
